cues.en: Let's start from the top with what is machine learning.
cues.zh: 從頭開始，什麼是機器學習？

cues.en: Well, machine learning is broad.
cues.zh: 機器學習涵蓋很廣。

cues.en: It contains many different aspects and you'll see many different definitions of it online.
cues.zh: 包含許多面向，網路上也會看到不同定義。

cues.en: But for the sake of this course, we're going to keep it practical in a single sentence.
cues.zh: 這門課為了實用，先用一句話說明。

cues.en: Machine learning is using an algorithm or computer program to learn about different patterns in data,
cues.zh: 機器學習就是用演算法或電腦程式，學習資料裡的各種模式，

cues.en: and then taking that algorithm and what it's learned to make predictions about the future using similar data.
cues.zh: 再利用演算法學到的內容，根據類似資料，預測未來。

cues.en: Machine learning algorithms are also called models, and we'll use the term interchangeably throughout the course.
cues.zh: 機器學習演算法也稱模型，課程中會交替使用這兩個詞。

cues.en: How machine learning algorithms differ from normal algorithms in computer programs is the learning aspect.
cues.zh: 與一般電腦程式演算法的不同，在於學習這一部分。

cues.en: Let's use an example where a normal algorithm could be a set of instructions such as how to turn a pile of raw ingredients into your favorite honey mustard chicken dish.
cues.zh: 舉例來說，一般演算法是一組指令，像把原料變成最愛的蜂蜜芥末雞料理。

cues.en: The set of instructions might start out by saying, First, cut up the vegetables, then season the
cues.zh: 指令可能先說，切蔬菜，再替雞肉，

cues.en: chicken, then preheat the oven, etc. And if you follow these steps correctly, you'll end up with your favorite honey mustard chicken dish or let's make it me hungry.
cues.zh: 調味，然後預熱烤箱等等；正確照步驟做，就會得到蜂蜜芥末雞。講得我都餓了。

cues.en: Actually, we'll get back to it.
cues.zh: 先回到主題。

cues.en: What's important to note here is you started with an input, your set of ingredients and a set of instructions on what to do to get to your favorite dish.
cues.zh: 重點是，先有輸入，也就是食材，再有一組指令，告訴你如何做出最愛的料理。

cues.en: What happens with a machine learning algorithm is instead of starting with an input and a set of instructions, you start with an input and an ideal output.
cues.zh: 機器學習演算法則不同，不是先有輸入和指令，而是先有輸入與理想輸出。

cues.en: In our case, the ingredients is the input and the output is our favorite chicken dish.
cues.zh: 這裡輸入是食材，輸出是最愛的雞肉料理。

cues.en: And what a machine learning algorithm does is it looks at the input, the raw ingredients, and then
cues.zh: 演算法先查看輸入，也就是原始食材，再，

cues.en: it looks at the output, the favorite chicken dish, and it tries to figure out the set of instructions in between these two.
cues.zh: 查看輸出，也就是最愛的雞肉料理，試著找出兩者之間的指令。

cues.en: Now think about this.
cues.zh: 想一想。

cues.en: If you tried to do this on your first try, you might not get great results.
cues.zh: 第一次嘗試，結果可能不好。

cues.en: You might put in too much spice and the dishes come out far too hot.
cues.zh: 也許香料放太多，料理變得太辣。

cues.en: When your second try, you get a little closer.
cues.zh: 第二次就接近一些。

cues.en: But when it comes to machine learning, sometimes there may be hundreds, thousands or tens of thousands of these combinations of inputs and outputs.
cues.zh: 機器學習可能有數百、數千，甚至數萬組輸入與輸出。

cues.en: If you looked at the set of ingredients and ideal outputs, your favorite chicken dish 100 plus times,
cues.zh: 如果查看食材與理想料理的組合超過 100 次，

cues.en: you'd probably get pretty good or pretty close to figuring out what the set of instructions are to make that dish.
cues.zh: 應該會很擅長，或很接近找出製作這道菜的步驟。

cues.en: Now we're missing out a few steps here, but this is what machine models do in a nutshell.
cues.zh: 這裡略過一些步驟，但機器學習模型大致就是如此。

cues.en: They find patterns collected in data so we can use those patterns for future problems.
cues.zh: 找出資料中的模式，以便處理未來的問題。

cues.en: In our chicken dish example, a machine learning algorithm might find a way to create a delicious chicken dish, given the right ingredients that way, instead of thinking about what dish we could make with
cues.zh: 雞肉料理的例子裡，演算法可能找出如何用合適食材做出美味料理，不用再自己思考冰箱裡，

cues.en: what's in the fridge.
cues.zh: 現有食材能做什麼。

cues.en: The machine learning algorithm tells us you might be thinking, Hey, I've heard about data analysis and data science as well.
cues.zh: 演算法會告訴我們；你可能會問，也聽過資料分析與資料科學。

cues.en: How are all these different?
cues.zh: 它們有什麼不同？

cues.en: Great question.
cues.zh: 問得好。

cues.en: Data analysis is looking at a set of data and gaining an understanding of it by comparing different examples, different features and making visualizations like graphs.
cues.zh: 資料分析是查看資料，透過比較不同範例、特徵，以及繪製圖表等視覺化方式，取得理解。

cues.en: For our example, this might be looking at different samples of ingredients and comparing them.
cues.zh: 這個例子裡，就是查看並比較不同組食材。

cues.en: What all the ingredients have in common are some of them missing something which have the most of a certain type of thing?
cues.zh: 有哪些共同點？有些缺少什麼？哪一組的某種食材最多？

cues.en: Data science is running experiments on a set of data with the hopes of finding actionable insights within it.
cues.zh: 資料科學是對資料做實驗，希望找到可付諸行動的洞見。

cues.en: One of these experiments may be to build a machine learning model.
cues.zh: 其中一種實驗，可能是建立機器學習模型。

cues.en: This model might look at 10,000 different sets of ingredients and 10,000 different chicken dishes.
cues.zh: 模型可能查看 10,000 組不同食材，以及 10,000 種雞肉料理。

cues.en: Then tell us, based on a set of new ingredients that we have, which chicken dish these ingredients are most likely to make.
cues.zh: 再根據新的一組食材，告訴我們最可能做出哪道雞肉料理。

cues.en: You can consider data analysis and machine learning as a part of data science.
cues.zh: 可以把資料分析與機器學習，視為資料科學的一部分。

cues.en: Don't worry if all of this seems unclear for now.
cues.zh: 現在還不清楚，不用擔心。

cues.en: By the end of this course, you'll have had plenty of hands on experience with all of these.
cues.zh: 完成課程時，會有很多親自實作的經驗。

cues.en: Before the next lesson, take a minute to think about an example of a set of instructions you followed before.
cues.zh: 下一堂之前，花一分鐘想想，曾經照著執行的一組指令。

cues.en: Do you think if you were shown the inputs and the end goal of something enough times, you could work backwards and figure out the instructions it took to get there.
cues.zh: 如果看夠多次輸入與最終目標，覺得能反推並找出達成目標的步驟嗎？
